versions.changelog:
psychology-assessment-creator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the psychology-assessment-creator skill.
- Provides end-to-end support for creating psychological assessments, covering topic planning, question design, scoring rules, result content, and optimization.
- Integrates core psychological theory, structured design principles, and data-driven iteration processes.
- Includes best practices, quality checklists, and ethical guidelines for professional content production.
- Suitable for various use cases needing development of high-quality psychological evaluation content.
